item.title: SpiceCrypt: A Python library for decrypting LTspice encrypted model files
item.description:
📝 decrypt_stream(input_file, output_file=None, is_ltspice_file=None) Stream-decrypt from a file path or file object. Supports both the text-based hex/DES format and the Binary File format. output_file (optional): File path (str) or binary-mode file object.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/jtsylve/spice-crypt

item.title: Federal Right to Privacy Act – Draft legislation
item.description:
📝 Your car can become a mobile telemetry device. Your child's school has a wealth of data spread through untrustworthy vendors including health records, birth certificates, videos, photos. Society's expectation was that a photo could be taken of you, your car, your family out in public, but the likelihood until recently approached zero.
🔗 Read more: https://righttoprivacyact.github.io

item.title: The emergence of print-on-demand Amazon paperback books
item.description:
📝 As reading has become my favorite pastime, I’ve also started buying many more books. And receiving books in the mail feels like mini-Christmas, every time. I quite like this presentation, but it's pretty unusual.
